author: Sad_Blueberry_7722
body: If you’re ever in San Clemente and like chicken/beef and rice bowls Super Bowl is the spot

author: NoVacayAtWork
body:
Literally picked up from them last night. Super Bowl Express should have fifty locations - they’re SO GOOD. The udon is good, the teriyaki platters are good, the sushi is good.

They deserve so much more business than they have.
